brief: Dhaka-focused courier and logistics for online sellers, food businesses and growing local brands. The logo is final and in production; this board shows the finished identity in use.
criteria: Faithful to the production logo, clean vector masters, legible at 16 px, works in one colour and in Bangla, ready for every touchpoint.

concepts.name: Parcel Fly
concepts.idea: A parcel given wings: three feathers carry the diamond parcel, its two facets form the arrow to the doorstep.
rationale: Rebuilt from the production artwork on exact geometry: 256-unit parcel, 26-unit channels, 45 degree edges
Six flat colours climb from navy to mint, from pickup to delivery; one-colour and on-dark versions included
Bangla lockup in Mina Bold with matched stem weight; app icons use a flight crop that reads at 16 px

recommendation: Use the stacked logo as the primary signature, the horizontal lockup in headers and the flight-crop icon wherever space is small.
next_steps: Replace app and web icons in the four apps with icons/app/<app>
Align the web colour tokens with colors/globals-oklch-snippet.css
Run a trademark search and proof CMYK/Pantone values before large print runs
